reseal_history.reason: Catalog instruction (config/cds/domains/financial_aid.yaml, all twelve h14_* metrics): 'a blank cell in this or any other visible H14 coordinate is not_reported, never false, and must not be inferred from another cell.' Three independent adjudications (Caltech at original seal time, plus fresh UGA and UCF re-adjudications) all ruled: a visibly-present but unticked H14 checkbox is `blank` with no value -- never `present`/`false`.
reseal_history.change_applied: status: present -> blank, value: false -> null

notes: 392 of 394 values were read from an interactive AcroForm field in the source PDF; no value was inferred from a model. 2 values (identity.academic_year, cost.cost_academic_year) have no AcroForm field and were transcribed by hand from rendered page text (source='rendered_text') after visual confirmation. Checkbox convention: a checkbox widget that exists on the form is always status=present (value true/false). status=blank is used for fill-in cells that exist and are empty, and for Yes/No or multi-option radio groups left entirely unselected (an unanswered radio is not a 'no'). status=absent means the question does not exist in this form edition. Per an orchestrator ruling, 2 AcroForm values (outcomes.primary_all_students_six_year_graduation_rate_ratio, outcomes.primary_pell_grant_six_year_graduation_rate_ratio) were superseded by their rendered widget appearance ('0.88' / '0.84') because the raw field value (0.8807 / .83534) carries precision that is never visible on the page and so is not a fair extraction target; the superseded raw values are preserved per-entry under 'acroform_raw_value'. No rounding tolerance was added to the scorer for this.
